title: 瀨戶大橋橋群~Seto Ohashi bridge network
focus: 9.4 km 海峽上的六座公路鐵路兩用橋：橋型配置、連續懸索橋、共用錨碇、設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土~Six road–rail bridges across 9.4 km of strait: type selection, continuous suspension spans, a shared anchorage, placed caissons and prepacked concrete
summary: 瀨戶大橋是連接本州岡山與四國香川的六座橋梁，海峽段約 9.4 km，全部為上層公路、下層鐵路的雙層結構，1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。本課從如何沿海峽配置三座懸索橋、兩座斜張橋與一座桁架橋出發，說明南北備讚瀨戶大橋的三跨連續構造與索股交叉的共用錨碇、11 座設置沉箱與預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與工廠全尺寸預組，最後談鍍鋅鋼絲防蝕、乾燥空氣與公路鐵路並存下的維護。~Seto Ohashi is a group of six bridges linking Okayama on Honshu with Kagawa on Shikoku across about 9.4 km of sea, all double-deck with road above and rail below, opened together on 10 April 1988. The course starts from how three suspension bridges, two cable-stayed bridges and a truss bridge were arranged along the strait, explains the three-span continuous Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto bridges and their shared anchorage where strands cross, eleven placed caissons with prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and full factory trial assembly, and ends with galvanised-wire protection, dry air and maintenance with road and rail side by side.

units.anchor: 海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置~Type layout over 9.4 km
units.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數~Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait
units.mechanism: 瀨戶大橋並非單一橋梁，而是一條跨越塩飽諸島的鏈：下津井瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，中央跨 940 m）、櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋（斜張橋，各 420 m）、與島橋（桁架橋，最大跨 245 m）、北備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，990 m）與南備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，1,100 m）。主要航道與深水處用懸索橋大跨越過，島嶼之間較淺且船舶較小的水道用斜張橋與桁架橋，讓每一段的跨徑與基礎數量都配合水深、航道與島嶼位置。海中基礎是最昂貴、最受潮流與天候限制的工作，因此減少海中基礎數量是配置的核心考量。~Seto Ohashi is not one bridge but a chain across the Shiwaku Islands: Shimotsui-Seto (suspension, 940 m centre span), the Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima bridges (cable-stayed, 420 m each), Yoshima (truss, 245 m maximum span), Kita Bisan-Seto (suspension, 990 m) and Minami Bisan-Seto (suspension, 1,100 m). Main channels and deep water are crossed by long suspension spans, while shallower inter-island waters with smaller ships use cable-stayed and truss bridges, so each segment's span and foundation count fit water depth, navigation and island positions. Marine foundations are the most expensive work and the most constrained by currents and weather, so reducing their number is central to the layout.
units.model: 若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎；實際工程只製作 11 座大型設置沉箱作為主要海中基礎。若懸索橋垂跨比取 1/10，三座懸索橋主纜垂度約為 94 m、99 m 與 110 m，決定了塔高的主要部分。垂跨比為教學假設。~Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations; the project built only 11 large placed caissons as its main marine foundations. With a 1/10 sag ratio, the three suspension bridges' cable sags would be about 94 m, 99 m and 110 m, setting most of each tower's height. The sag ratio is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 以航道主管機關核定的航道寬度與淨空、海底地形與地質鑽探資料，比較不同橋型配置的海中基礎數、施工天數與風險；定案後把每座橋的橋型、跨徑與基礎位置列入整體配置圖，作為各橋設計的共同基準。~Compare layouts by marine foundation count, construction days and risk, using channel widths and clearances approved by the navigation authority, seabed topography and borehole data; once fixed, record each bridge's type, spans and foundation locations on a master layout as the common basis for all individual designs.
units.failure: 若為追求單一橋型而在淺水區也使用大跨懸索橋，錨碇與塔的成本會不成比例；反之在主航道使用短跨，海中基礎增加，不僅工期與潮流風險上升，也增加船舶撞擊機率。~Using long suspension spans even in shallow water for the sake of a single type makes anchorages and towers disproportionately costly; short spans in the main channel multiply marine foundations, raising schedule and tidal risk as well as ship-collision probability.
units.misconception: 跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。~A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout.
units.practice: 大型跨海工程的配置報告應以表格比較各段的水深、航道、基礎數與橋型方案，並保存被淘汰方案的理由；日後若有新增航道需求或維修策略變更，可回到此基準評估影響。~The layout report for a major sea crossing should tabulate water depth, channel, foundation count and type options for each segment and keep the reasons for rejected options, so later new channel demands or maintenance strategy changes can be assessed against that baseline.

units.anchor: 三跨連續加勁桁~Three-span continuous truss
units.title: 鐵路通行與連續懸索橋~Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans
units.mechanism: 業主將北、南備讚瀨戶大橋描述為三跨連續加勁桁架懸索橋。一般公路懸索橋常在橋塔處把加勁梁分開以鉸接或伸縮縫連接，鐵路卻難以接受橋塔處的折角：列車通過時主跨下垂、邊跨上揚，兩側梁端轉角相加，形成軌道的突然轉折。把加勁桁在塔處做成連續，能大幅減少這個折角，代價是塔處的彎矩與支承反力增加，以及溫度與活載下更複雜的縱向位移。這是瀨戶大橋作為公路鐵路兩用懸索橋的關鍵選擇之一。~The owner describes Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto as three-span continuous truss-stiffened suspension bridges. Road suspension bridges often separate the stiffening girder at the towers with hinges or expansion joints, but rail cannot easily accept an angle break there: as a train crosses, the main span sags and the side span rises, and the two girder-end rotations add up to a sudden kink in the track. Making the stiffening truss continuous over the towers greatly reduces this kink, at the price of larger bending moments and bearing reactions at the towers and more complex longitudinal movement under temperature and live load. This was one of the key choices that made Seto Ohashi a road–rail suspension bridge.
units.model: 以拋物線撓度形狀估算梁端轉角 θ ≈ 4δ/L。取主跨 L = 1,100 m、列車荷重下最大撓度 δ = 2.0 m：θ ≈ 4×2.0/1,100 ≈ 0.0073 rad；若塔處為鉸接，兩側轉角相加的折角可達約 0.0145 rad。連續構造把折角限制在梁的連續曲率內，鐵路容許折角則遠小於此值。數值為教學假設。~Estimate girder-end rotation from a parabolic deflection shape, θ ≈ 4δ/L. With main span L = 1,100 m and maximum deflection under train load δ = 2.0 m: θ ≈ 4×2.0/1,100 ≈ 0.0073 rad; with a hinge at the tower the two rotations add to a kink of about 0.0145 rad. Continuity keeps the angle within the girder's smooth curvature, while the permissible rail kink is far smaller. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以有限元素模型針對單線與雙線列車、公路車隊與溫度組合，輸出塔處與梁端的軌道折角、縱向位移與支承反力，與鐵路軌道標準比較；通車前以試運轉列車量測軌道高低差與加速度，確認乘坐品質。~Use the finite-element model with single- and double-track trains, road traffic and temperature combinations to output track angle breaks, longitudinal movement and bearing reactions at towers and girder ends against railway track standards; before opening measure track irregularity and car-body acceleration with test trains to confirm ride quality.
units.failure: 若只以公路標準設計塔處接頭，列車通過時的折角與衝擊會加速軌道部件、支承與伸縮裝置的損耗，嚴重時需要限速；連續梁在塔處的負彎矩若低估，上弦或下弦構件可能疲勞開裂。~Designing tower joints only to road standards lets train-induced kinks and impact wear track components, bearings and expansion devices quickly, possibly forcing speed limits; underestimating negative moment at the towers in a continuous girder can lead to fatigue cracking of chord members.
units.misconception: 懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。~A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation.
units.practice: 公路鐵路兩用橋應由橋梁與鐵路單位共同制定軌道折角、伸縮量與支承反力的設計表，並在竣工後建立塔處與梁端的長期位移與轉角監測，作為維護與限速決策的依據。~For road–rail bridges the bridge and railway parties should jointly fix design tables for track kink, expansion and bearing reaction, and after completion set up long-term movement and rotation monitoring at towers and girder ends as the basis for maintenance and speed decisions.

units.anchor: 共用錨碇索股交叉~Shared anchorage strand crossing
units.title: 107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇~The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage
units.mechanism: 北、南備讚瀨戶大橋相鄰而建，兩橋之間共用一座錨碇，兩側主纜的索股在錨碇內交叉錨定：北備讚為 234 股、南備讚為 271 股，業主稱這種構造為世界首例。每股由 127 根直徑約 5 mm 的平行鋼絲排成六角形，不扭絞。南備讚瀨戶大橋的主纜最大，直徑 107 cm，承受約 45,000 t 的張力。共用錨碇節省了一座巨大的重力式構造，但必須同時承受兩橋方向相反的主纜力，並在兩橋荷重不平衡時保持穩定。~Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto stand side by side and share one anchorage between them, where the strands of both cables cross and are anchored: 234 strands for Kita Bisan-Seto and 271 for Minami Bisan-Seto, a structure the owner calls a world first. Each strand is 127 parallel wires of about 5 mm laid in a hexagon, not twisted. Minami Bisan-Seto's cable is the largest, 107 cm in diameter and carrying about 45,000 t of tension. The shared anchorage saved one huge gravity structure, but it must resist cable forces from both bridges in opposite directions and stay stable when their loads are unbalanced.
units.model: 南備讚 271×127 = 34,417 根。張力 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN；若鋼絲強度 1,570 N/mm²、安全係數取 2.5，所需面積 A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m²，每根約 20.4 mm²，對應直徑 ≈ 5.10 mm，與公開的「約 5 mm」一致；毛面積 π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m²，空隙率 ≈ 22%。強度與安全係數為教學假設。~Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires. A tension of 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN, with wire strength 1,570 N/mm² and safety factor 2.5, needs A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m², about 20.4 mm² per wire, a diameter ≈ 5.10 mm, consistent with the published ‘about 5 mm’; gross area π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 22%. Strength and safety factor are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 共用錨碇的穩定檢核要包含兩橋同時滿載、單橋滿載另一橋空載、溫度差與地震等組合，計算合力方向與基底反力分布；施工時逐股量測錨固力與索股垂度，確認兩側索股交叉排列與錨頭位置符合圖說。~Stability checks of the shared anchorage must cover both bridges fully loaded, one loaded with the other empty, temperature differences and earthquake, computing resultant direction and base-pressure distribution; during construction measure anchoring force and sag strand by strand, confirming the crossing arrangement and socket positions match the drawings.
units.failure: 若只檢核兩橋對稱受力，單側滿載時錨碇的合力偏心可能使基底一側壓力過大或另一側脫開；索股交叉區排列錯誤則造成錨頭擁擠、受力不均，日後也難以檢查與更換。~Checking only symmetric loading can miss the eccentric resultant when one bridge is loaded, overstressing one side of the base or lifting the other; misarranged strands in the crossing zone crowd sockets, share load unevenly and are hard to inspect or replace later.
units.misconception: 兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。~With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small.
units.practice: 共用錨碇的設計基準應列出所有不平衡荷重組合與容許偏心，並在錨碇內保留足夠的檢查通道與照明，讓每一個索股錨頭都能定期目視與量測。~The design basis for a shared anchorage should list every unbalanced load combination and the allowable eccentricity, and the anchorage must keep enough inspection access and lighting so every strand socket can be seen and measured periodically.

units.title: 設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土~Placed caissons and prepacked concrete
units.mechanism: 瀨戶大橋的海中基礎採用設置沉箱工法：在完成整平的岩盤上放置巨大的箱形鋼製模板，再在內部填充水中混凝土，共製作 11 座。以其中一例而言，沉箱寬 59 m、長 75 m、高 55 m、重約 18,000 t，在造船廠船塢製作近 2 年，與現場作業平行進行以縮短工期。沉箱內的水中混凝土採用預壘骨材工法：先在海水中投放 80 至 150 mm 的大粒徑骨材，再從注入管壓入砂漿，把骨材間的海水擠出；砂漿船「世紀」每日最多可製造 5,800 m³ 砂漿，一旦開始注入就必須三晝夜連續作業。~Seto Ohashi's marine foundations used the placed-caisson method: a huge box-shaped steel form is set on a levelled rock surface and filled with underwater concrete, eleven in all. One example caisson is 59 m wide, 75 m long and 55 m high, weighs about 18,000 t and took nearly two years to build in a shipyard dock, in parallel with site work to shorten the schedule. The underwater concrete inside used the prepacked-aggregate method: 80 to 150 mm aggregate is first placed in the seawater, then mortar is pumped in through injection pipes to displace the water between stones; the mortar plant ship Seiki could produce up to 5,800 m³ a day, and once injection started it ran continuously for three days and nights.
units.model: 預壘骨材的空隙率取 40%，每日 5,800 m³ 砂漿可完成約 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ 的混凝土；三晝夜約 43,500 m³。沉箱外廓體積 59×75×55 ≈ 243,000 m³，扣除隔艙與鋼殼仍需多次分層注入。若空隙率為 45%，每日完成量降為約 12,900 m³。空隙率為教學假設。~Taking a 40% void ratio for the prepacked aggregate, 5,800 m³ of mortar a day completes about 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ of concrete, about 43,500 m³ in three days and nights. The caisson envelope is 59×75×55 ≈ 243,000 m³, so even after deducting partitions and shell it needs several injection lifts. At 45% voids the daily output drops to about 12,900 m³. The void ratio is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 注入過程中以測深與注入管周邊的砂漿面計量測砂漿上升高度，確認注入管埋入深度與各區均勻上升；完成後鑽心取樣檢查骨材間是否充填密實、有無海水夾層或泥膜，並以試體確認砂漿強度與流動性。~During injection measure mortar rise with soundings and gauges around the pipes, confirming pipe embedment and even rise in every zone; afterwards core to check that voids between stones are fully filled without seawater pockets or silt films, and confirm mortar strength and flow with specimens.
units.failure: 骨材在投放後若被潮流帶入泥砂或生物附著，砂漿無法與骨材緊密結合，形成弱面；注入若中斷超過允許時間，新舊砂漿之間產生冷縫，基礎內部出現不連續面，降低抗剪與耐久性。~If silt or marine growth coats the aggregate after placement, mortar cannot bond tightly and weak planes form; interrupting injection beyond the allowable time leaves cold joints between old and new mortar, creating internal discontinuities that cut shear capacity and durability.
units.misconception: 預壘骨材混凝土只要砂漿強度夠，品質就有保證。~Prepacked concrete is guaranteed as long as the mortar is strong enough.
units.practice: 預壘骨材工法應訂定骨材清洗與投放後的最長等待時間、注入管間距、連續作業的備援（第二套泵與發電機）與中斷處理程序，並以鑽心結果作為驗收停留點。~The prepacked method needs limits on aggregate washing and the maximum wait after placement, injection-pipe spacing, back-up for continuous work (spare pumps and generators) and a procedure for interruptions, with core results as the acceptance hold point.

units.anchor: 起重船牽引導索~Crane-ship pilot rope
units.title: 導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤~Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels
units.mechanism: 過去的懸索橋把第一條導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過海峽，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋航道繁忙，因此改以起重船把導索吊在高處跨越。導索就位後，約 10 條較粗的鋼索架在其上，鋪上鋼絲網與雙層纖維網，形成寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m 的貓道，貓道之間以橫向便橋連接。索股在架設前 4 年以上就開始製造，每股捲在重近 40 t 的捲盤上，以貨運列車陸運，再以牽引索在兩座錨碇間拉送。~Earlier suspension bridges floated the first pilot rope on buoys and towed it across by boat, which meant closing the channel; Seto Ohashi's channels were too busy, so a crane ship held the pilot rope high as it crossed. With the pilot rope in place, about ten heavier ropes were laid on it and covered with wire mesh and a double fibre net to form a catwalk 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails, linked by cross-bridges. Strand fabrication began more than four years before erection; each strand was wound on a reel weighing nearly 40 t, carried overland by freight train and hauled between the anchorages by a traction rope.
units.model: 單股重量 W = n·a·L·ρ。取 127 根、每根 20.4 mm²、索股長 1,800 m、鋼密度 7,850 kg/m³：W = 127×20.4×10⁻⁶×1,800×7,850 ≈ 36.6 t，加上捲盤後接近公開的「近 40 t」。若索股長 2,000 m，單股約 40.7 t，可能超過捲盤與運輸限制。索股長度與單絲面積為教學假設。~Strand weight W = n·a·L·ρ. With 127 wires of 20.4 mm², a strand length of 1,800 m and steel at 7,850 kg/m³: W = 127×20.4×10⁻⁶×1,800×7,850 ≈ 36.6 t, close to the published ‘nearly 40 t’ once the reel is added. A 2,000 m strand would weigh about 40.7 t and could exceed reel and transport limits. Strand length and wire area are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 導索跨越前與航道主管機關確認作業時段與起重船位置，跨越中量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後做荷重與防風試驗、檢查網片與扶手；每股牽引前核對捲盤編號、長度標記與錨頭，牽引後量測垂度並記錄溫度。~Before the crossing confirm working hours and crane-ship position with the navigation authority and measure the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built carry out load and wind checks and inspect mesh and handrails; before hauling each strand check reel number, length marks and sockets, and after hauling measure sag and record temperature.
units.failure: 導索若在跨越時下垂到航道淨空以下，可能與船舶勾掛；貓道網片或橫向便橋固定不良，強風中晃動劇烈，危及作業人員並損傷已架設索股；捲盤運輸或展開時刮傷鋼絲鍍鋅層，日後成為腐蝕起點。~A pilot rope sagging below the clearance during the crossing can snag a ship; poorly fixed catwalk mesh or cross-bridges swing violently in strong wind, endangering workers and damaging strands already erected; scratching galvanising during reel transport or unwinding creates future corrosion sites.
units.misconception: 貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。~A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design.
units.practice: 貓道與牽引設備屬於臨時結構，必須有獨立的設計計算、風速停工準則與每日檢查表，並由臨時工程設計者與施工主管共同簽認；導索跨越作業須取得海事主管機關的許可與航行警告。~Catwalks and hauling gear are temporary structures needing their own design calculations, stop-work wind speeds and daily checklists, signed by the temporary-works designer and the site manager; the pilot-rope crossing requires marine-authority approval and a navigation warning.

units.anchor: 1,500 噸塔邊大塊~1,500 t tower blocks
units.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開~Truss erection and the jacked-open closure
units.mechanism: 業主記載加勁桁在工廠先做全尺寸立體預組以確認精度，再塗裝並依現場進度出貨。南備讚瀨戶大橋把每座塔附近四個格間約 1,500 t 在工廠組成大塊，由起重船一次吊放，提早騰出橋上空間給後續的架設設備；之後以兩個格間為一組，以船運到塔邊吊起、用台車往前送，再由前端吊機安裝，反覆循環。隨著架設推進主纜形狀大幅變化，需要測量並平衡兩側進度。架設約一年後兩側在跨中會合，最後一段合龍前以塔邊的千斤頂把桁架往塔方向拉，擴大合龍間隙，嵌入後再放鬆。~The owner records that the stiffening truss was fully trial-assembled in three dimensions at the factory to confirm accuracy before painting and shipping to suit the site schedule. At Minami Bisan-Seto the four panels near each tower, about 1,500 t, were assembled into a large block and set by a crane ship in one lift, clearing the deck early for the following erection equipment; after that two-panel units were shipped to the tower, lifted, moved forward on carriages and placed by a crane at the leading end, in a repeating cycle. The cable shape changed greatly as erection advanced, requiring surveys and balanced progress on both sides. After about a year the two fronts met at mid-span; before the closure panel went in, jacks at the towers pulled the truss toward the towers to widen the gap, then were released.
units.model: 合龍間隙對溫度敏感：兩側各約 550 m 的桁架，溫度上升 10 °C 時間隙縮小 ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m。若合龍段需要 50 mm 的安裝餘裕，而當時溫度比設計高 5 °C（間隙少約 66 mm），就必須以千斤頂拉開約 116 mm 或等待降溫。數值為教學假設。~The closure gap is temperature sensitive: with about 550 m of truss on each side, a 10 °C rise closes the gap by ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m. If the closure panel needs 50 mm of fitting clearance and the temperature is 5 °C above design (gap about 66 mm short), jacks must open about 116 mm or the team must wait for cooling. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每個架設循環後量測主纜垂度、桁架高程與兩側進度差，與施工階段分析比較；合龍前連續數小時量測間隙與桁架溫度，建立間隙—溫度關係，選定合龍時段，並記錄千斤頂拉力與行程。~After each cycle measure cable sag, truss levels and the progress difference between sides against the stage analysis; before closure measure gap and truss temperature continuously for several hours to build a gap–temperature relation, choose the closure window, and log jack force and stroke.
units.failure: 若兩側架設進度不平衡，塔頂受不平衡水平力而偏位，主纜形狀偏離預測，合龍時兩端高程與角度對不上；在溫度上升時強行嵌入合龍段，可能使接頭產生強迫應力或無法栓接。~Unbalanced progress pulls the tower tops out of position and the cable away from its predicted shape, so the two ends do not match in level or angle at closure; forcing the closure panel in while temperature is rising can lock in stresses or prevent bolting.
units.misconception: 加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。~If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure.
units.practice: 合龍作業應有書面的溫度窗口、千斤頂容許拉力、間隙量測方法與停止條件，並由設計者確認合龍時的結構狀態；工廠全尺寸預組的量測紀錄須隨構件交付，作為現場比對依據。~Closure needs a written temperature window, allowable jack force, gap measurement method and stop conditions, with the designer confirming the structural state at closure; factory trial-assembly measurements should travel with the members as the reference for site checks.

units.anchor: 工廠全尺寸預組~Full factory trial assembly
units.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制~Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation
units.mechanism: 懸索橋加勁桁由數百個構件與接頭組成，每個接頭的小誤差在長跨中累積，最後決定合龍處能否對上、吊索位置是否與索夾一致，以及鐵路軌道是否平順。工廠全尺寸立體預組讓誤差在地面上就被發現並修正，而不是到了海上高空才發現孔位不合。誤差分為隨機誤差與系統誤差：隨機誤差會部分互相抵消，系統誤差（例如量尺溫度未修正、模具偏差）則每一節都朝同一方向累積，是預組最需要抓出來的對象。~A suspension stiffening truss is made of hundreds of members and joints, and small errors at each joint accumulate along a long span, deciding whether the closure fits, whether hanger positions match the cable bands and whether the rail track is smooth. Full three-dimensional trial assembly in the factory finds and fixes errors on the ground rather than discovering mismatched holes high above the sea. Errors are random or systematic: random errors partly cancel, while systematic ones, such as an uncorrected tape temperature or a jig offset, accumulate in the same direction at every panel and are what trial assembly most needs to catch.
units.model: 100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm；若每個接頭另有 1 mm 同向系統誤差，累積 100×1 = 100 mm，遠大於隨機部分。若系統誤差在預組中被找出並修正到 0.2 mm，累積只剩 20 mm。數值為教學假設。~With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm; an additional 1 mm systematic error per joint in the same direction accumulates to 100×1 = 100 mm, far larger than the random part. If trial assembly finds the systematic error and cuts it to 0.2 mm, the accumulation is only 20 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 預組時在固定溫度下以全站儀與鋼尺量測節點座標、全長、拱度與對角線，並修正量具溫度；把量測結果與設計座標比較，統計每節誤差的平均（系統）與標準差（隨機），超出允差的構件在出廠前修正並重新量測。~During trial assembly survey node coordinates, overall length, camber and diagonals by total station and steel tape at a stable temperature, correcting instrument temperature; compare results with design coordinates, separating the mean (systematic) and standard deviation (random) of panel errors, and correct and re-measure members outside tolerance before shipment.
units.failure: 若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點；鐵路軌道也可能因累積線形誤差而需要大量調整。~Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints; accumulated profile error may also require extensive rail-track adjustment.
units.misconception: 每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。~If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately.
units.practice: 製造規範應同時規定單構件允差與累積允差，並要求以統計方式報告預組誤差；量具校正、量測溫度與參考點須有紀錄，預組報告是出廠放行的停留點文件。~Fabrication specifications should set both member tolerances and accumulated tolerances and require trial-assembly errors to be reported statistically; instrument calibration, survey temperature and reference points must be recorded, and the trial-assembly report is the hold-point document for release from the factory.

units.anchor: 沉箱沉放繫留~Caisson mooring during sinking
units.title: 沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收~Caisson towing window and placement acceptance
units.mechanism: 業主記載沉箱出塢後以 12 艘拖船慢速拖到橋位，一旦開始拖航就不能中途停下，因此只在氣象與海象資料顯示至少 4 天穩定時才出發。沉放時先在海底預埋重約 900 t 的錨，沉箱上的絞車以鋼索連到錨上抵抗潮流，一邊注水下沉一邊調整位置，最後由大型起重船扶持控制姿態軟著陸。容許的設置誤差為 50 cm，業主指出所有沉箱都在此範圍內完成。~The owner records that after leaving the dock each caisson was towed slowly to site by 12 tugs; once towing began it could not stop, so departure waited for weather and sea data showing at least four stable days. For sinking, an anchor of about 900 t was pre-placed on the seabed and winches on the caisson pulled on wires to it against the tide, adjusting position as water was admitted, with a large crane vessel finally holding the caisson to control its attitude for a soft landing. The allowable placement error was 50 cm, and the owner states every caisson was placed within it.
units.model: 潮流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U²。取沉放中迎流面積 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m²、C_D = 1.2、流速 1.5 m/s：F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN（約 317 t 力），須由絞車、錨與起重船共同抵抗；流速增為 2.0 m/s 時 F 增為約 5.5 MN。面積、係數與流速為教學假設。~Tidal drag F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U². With a projected area during sinking of 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m², C_D = 1.2 and current 1.5 m/s: F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN (about 317 t-force), resisted jointly by winches, anchor and crane vessel; at 2.0 m/s F rises to about 5.5 MN. Area, coefficient and current are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 沉放全程以測量系統即時追蹤沉箱平面位置、高程與傾斜，並與潮流預報比對選擇平潮時段；著地後立即量測四角高程與中心座標，與 50 cm 容許誤差比較，合格後才開始投放骨材與注入砂漿。~Track plan position, level and tilt in real time throughout sinking, choosing slack-water windows from tidal forecasts; immediately after landing measure corner levels and centre coordinates against the 50 cm tolerance, and begin aggregate placement and mortar injection only after acceptance.
units.failure: 若低估潮流拖曳力，繫留鋼索或錨可能拖動，沉箱偏離預定位置甚至撞上已整平的岩盤邊緣；著地後才發現偏差超限時，重新浮起與再沉放的成本與風險都很高。~Underestimating tidal drag can drag mooring wires or the anchor, pushing the caisson off position or onto the edge of the levelled rock; discovering excess error only after landing makes refloating and re-sinking costly and risky.
units.misconception: 沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。~A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it.
units.practice: 拖航與沉放計畫要明列氣象窗口條件、潮流上限、繫留系統容量、通訊與緊急程序，並在出塢前舉行由業主、承包商與海事單位參加的放行會議；著地測量結果是後續工作的停留點。~The towing and sinking plan must state weather-window conditions, current limits, mooring capacity, communications and emergency procedures, with a go/no-go meeting of owner, contractor and marine authorities before leaving the dock; the landing survey is the hold point for following work.

units.anchor: 鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣~Galvanised wire and dry air
units.title: 主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善~Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection
units.mechanism: 業主說明，因島、大鳴門、大島與瀨戶大橋等較早的懸索橋，主纜採用鍍鋅鋼絲加防鏽劑與纏絲包覆；後來檢查舊有懸索橋時，拆開纏絲發現鋼絲已有鏽蝕，於是開發把乾燥空氣送入主纜的系統，並裝設在本州四國連絡橋的所有懸索橋。鍍鋅層是犧牲性的：只要纜內潮濕，鋅就逐年消耗，耗盡後鋼絲本體才開始生鏽。乾燥空氣不是取代鍍鋅，而是把鋅的消耗速度降到幾乎為零，讓既有的保護層長期有效。~The owner explains that earlier suspension bridges such as Innoshima, Ohnaruto, Ohshima and Seto Ohashi used galvanised wire with a rust inhibitor and wrapping; later inspections of existing suspension bridges found rust on wires once the wrapping was removed, so a system blowing dry air into the main cables was developed and installed on all the Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges. Galvanising is sacrificial: while the cable interior is damp, zinc is consumed year by year, and only when it is gone does the steel itself rust. Dry air does not replace galvanising; it cuts zinc consumption to nearly zero so the existing protection stays effective for the long term.
units.model: 鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 相當於厚度 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm。若潮濕纜內鋅的消耗率為 4 μm/年，約 42/4 ≈ 10.5 年即耗盡；若乾燥空氣把消耗率降到 0.1 μm/年，約需 420 年。消耗率為教學假設，實際值依濕度、氯鹽與溫度而定。~A zinc mass of 300 g/m² corresponds to 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm. If zinc is consumed at 4 μm a year in a damp cable, it is gone in about 42/4 ≈ 10.5 years; if dry air cuts the rate to 0.1 μm a year, it lasts about 420 years. Rates are teaching assumptions; real values depend on humidity, chlorides and temperature.
units.verify: 定期在主纜低點與索夾附近開窗，以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查鍍鋅層與鏽蝕等級，並取樣量測剩餘鋅量；同時比較送氣與排氣口的濕度紀錄，確認改善後的乾燥空氣系統讓各區段維持在管理目標以下。~Periodically open inspection windows at cable low points and near bands, wedge wires apart to grade zinc condition and rust, and sample remaining zinc; compare humidity records at inlets and outlets to confirm the improved dry-air system keeps every section below the management target.
units.failure: 若以為鍍鋅加纏絲就足以長期保護，水分可能在主纜低點與索夾下累積多年，鋅層耗盡後鋼絲開始點蝕甚至斷絲；送氣系統若只照顧容易到達的區段，遠端與高處可能仍維持潮濕。~Assuming galvanising and wrapping are enough lets water collect for years at low points and under bands, until zinc runs out and wires pit or break; a dry-air system that serves only easily reached sections can leave remote and high zones damp.
units.misconception: 鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。~Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem.
units.practice: 每座懸索橋應保存主纜開窗檢查的位置、等級與鋅量紀錄，並與乾燥空氣系統的濕度資料一起分析；送氣系統改善或擴充後，須重新確認每個區段的排氣濕度與流量。~Keep records of every cable inspection window, its grade and remaining zinc for each suspension bridge, analysed together with dry-air humidity data; after improving or extending the injection system, re-verify exhaust humidity and flow for every section.

units.anchor: 公路鐵路並存的維護~Maintenance with road and rail
units.title: 塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調~Coating management and night-time inspection coordination
units.mechanism: 本州四國連絡橋共約 400 萬 m² 的塗裝面積，業主預估塗裝將佔未來維護費用約一半，因此延長重塗週期是生命週期成本的主要策略；瀨戶大橋使用了抗紫外線的塗料，並以在固定點定期量測塗膜厚度決定重塗時機。加勁桁上設有供檢修車行駛的軌道，維護人員可沿桁架移動檢查。瀨戶大橋上層是高速公路、下層是鐵路，任何檢查或修繕都要同時協調道路交通管制與鐵路的夜間作業時段，近年業主仍持續進行夜間的打音檢查。~The Honshu-Shikoku bridges have about 4 million m² of painted surface, and the owner expects painting to make up about half of future maintenance cost, so extending the repainting cycle is the main life-cycle cost strategy; Seto Ohashi used a UV-resistant paint, and repainting is timed by periodically measuring film thickness at fixed points. Rails on the stiffening truss carry maintenance vehicles so crews can travel along it. With an expressway above and a railway below, every inspection or repair must coordinate road traffic management with night-time railway work windows, and the owner continues night-time hammer-sounding inspections.
units.model: 塗膜壽命 t = (d₀ − d_min)/r。設面漆初始厚度 d₀ = 30 μm、重塗門檻 d_min = 5 μm、年損耗 r = 1.0 μm/年：t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 年；若抗紫外線塗料把 r 降到 0.6 μm/年，t ≈ 42 年，重塗次數減少約四成。厚度與損耗率為教學假設。~Coating life t = (d₀ − d_min)/r. With an initial top-coat thickness d₀ = 30 μm, a repaint threshold d_min = 5 μm and wear r = 1.0 μm a year: t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 years; if a UV-resistant paint cuts r to 0.6 μm a year, t ≈ 42 years and the number of repaints falls by about 40%. Thicknesses and wear rates are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在各橋固定測點定期以膜厚計量測塗膜厚度，建立每個區位的損耗率並預測重塗時程；檢查作業前由道路與鐵路兩方確認作業時段、檢修車行駛路線與緊急撤離程序，作業後把發現事項輸入檢查資料庫並以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。~Measure film thickness at fixed points on every bridge periodically, deriving wear rates per zone to forecast repainting; before inspection confirm work windows, maintenance-vehicle routes and emergency withdrawal with both road and rail parties, and afterwards enter findings into the inspection database and update the plan through a PDCA cycle.
units.failure: 若重塗時機只依年數而不量測膜厚，可能在塗膜仍良好時過早重塗，或在已露底時才處理，鋼材開始鏽蝕；道路與鐵路的作業時段未協調，檢查覆蓋率不足，部分區段長期未被近距離檢查。~Timing repainting by age without measuring film thickness either repaints too early while coatings are fine or too late after steel is exposed and rusting; uncoordinated road and rail work windows reduce inspection coverage, leaving some zones without close inspection for years.
units.misconception: 鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。~Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary.
units.practice: 維護計畫應把塗膜量測點、損耗率、預測重塗年份與實際作業紀錄放在同一系統，並與鐵路營運單位簽訂年度作業時段協議；交接文件須包含檢修軌道與檢修車的檢查與維修程序。~The maintenance plan should keep film-thickness points, wear rates, forecast repaint years and actual work records in one system and agree annual work windows with the railway operator; handover documents must include inspection and maintenance procedures for the maintenance rails and vehicles.

example: 設計練習：比較南備讚瀨戶大橋型懸索橋在不同鋼絲直徑下的主纜狀態。主纜 271 股×127 根 = 34,417 根鋼絲，張力約 45,000 t（≈ 441 MN），主纜直徑 107 cm（毛面積 0.899 m²）。若鋼絲直徑 5.10 mm，單絲面積 20.4 mm²，總面積 ≈ 0.703 m²，應力 ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm²，對 1,570 N/mm² 鋼絲的安全係數 ≈ 2.50，空隙率 ≈ 22%。若直徑為 5.00 mm，單絲 19.6 mm²、總面積 ≈ 0.676 m²，應力 ≈ 653 N/mm²、係數 ≈ 2.40，空隙率 ≈ 25%；若為 5.20 mm，總面積 ≈ 0.731 m²、係數 ≈ 2.60、空隙率 ≈ 19%。可見「約 5 mm」的 0.1 mm 差異就會改變安全係數約 4% 與空隙率約 3 個百分點。除公開的股數、直徑與張力外，數值為教學假設，不代表瀨戶大橋的設計計算。~Design exercise: compare the cable state of a Minami Bisan-Seto type suspension bridge for different wire diameters. The cable has 271 strands × 127 wires = 34,417 wires, a tension of about 45,000 t (≈ 441 MN) and a diameter of 107 cm (gross area 0.899 m²). With 5.10 mm wire, each wire is 20.4 mm², the total area ≈ 0.703 m², the stress ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm², the safety factor on 1,570 N/mm² wire ≈ 2.50 and the void ratio ≈ 22%. With 5.00 mm wire, each is 19.6 mm², the total ≈ 0.676 m², the stress ≈ 653 N/mm², the factor ≈ 2.40 and voids ≈ 25%; with 5.20 mm, the total ≈ 0.731 m², the factor ≈ 2.60 and voids ≈ 19%. A 0.1 mm difference within ‘about 5 mm’ changes the safety factor by about 4% and the void ratio by about 3 points. Apart from the published strand count, diameter and tension, values are teaching assumptions, not Seto Ohashi design calculations.
history: 本州四國連絡橋公團規劃三條連絡路線，瀨戶大橋是其中唯一兼有鐵路的兒島—坂出路線，1978 年 10 月 10 日舉行動土典禮，北、南備讚瀨戶大橋於 1979 年 1 月現場開工，下津井瀨戶大橋於 1981 年、櫃石島橋於 1982 年開工，六座橋於 1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。工程以 11 座設置沉箱、預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與共用錨碇等技術完成，經驗直接延續到明石海峽大橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Authority planned three routes, and Seto Ohashi on the Kojima–Sakaide route is the only one that also carries rail; the ground-breaking ceremony was held on 10 October 1978, site work on Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto began in January 1979, Shimotsui-Seto in 1981 and Hitsuishijima in 1982, and all six bridges opened together on 10 April 1988. The project was completed with eleven placed caissons, prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and a shared anchorage, experience that carried directly into the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 海峽段約 9.4 km，由六座上層公路、下層鐵路的雙層橋組成~The sea section is about 9.4 km, made up of six double-deck bridges with road above and rail below
下津井瀨戶大橋中央跨 940 m，北備讚 990 m，南備讚 1,100 m~Centre spans: Shimotsui-Seto 940 m, Kita Bisan-Seto 990 m and Minami Bisan-Seto 1,100 m
櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋為斜張橋，中央跨各 420 m；與島橋為桁架橋，最大跨 245 m~Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima are cable-stayed with 420 m centre spans; Yoshima is a truss with a 245 m maximum span
六座橋於 1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車~All six bridges opened together on 10 April 1988
共製作 11 座設置沉箱，其中一例寬 59 m、長 75 m、高 55 m、重約 18,000 t~Eleven placed caissons were built; one example is 59 m wide, 75 m long, 55 m high and about 18,000 t
沉箱設置容許誤差 50 cm，拖航需至少 4 天穩定天候並以 12 艘拖船執行~Caisson placement tolerance was 50 cm; towing needed at least four stable days and 12 tugs
預壘骨材粒徑 80 至 150 mm，砂漿船每日最多製造 5,800 m³ 砂漿~Prepacked aggregate was 80 to 150 mm, and the mortar ship could make up to 5,800 m³ a day
南備讚主纜直徑 107 cm、張力約 45,000 t，每股 127 根約 5 mm 鋼絲~Minami Bisan-Seto's cable is 107 cm in diameter with about 45,000 t of tension, 127 wires of about 5 mm per strand
北、南備讚共用錨碇內索股交叉，分別為 234 股與 271 股~Strands cross in the shared Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto anchorage, 234 and 271 strands respectively
貓道寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m~Catwalks were 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails
